name: Patchogue Theatre for the Performing Arts

evidence.note: Official seating chart shows fixed rows of numbered seats on the main level and balcony.
Listing calls it Suffolk County's largest theater with nearly 1,200 seats.
Official event page for Yachtley Crew on Oct 3 (reserved seating, buy-tickets page).

dancing.notes: Concerts here are reserved-seat shows in a traditional theater, and there is no dance floor. Go for the show, not for dancing.

description: A historic nonprofit theater on Main Street in Patchogue village with nearly 1,200 seats. It hosts touring concerts, tribute bands, comedy and family shows.
factsSource: Checked October 4, 2026. Sources: patchoguetheatre.org, youtube.com, tiktok.com.
reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Both gigs confirmed: Yachtley Crew Sat Oct 3 (8 pm per ticket sites) and Ann Wilson Sun Oct 4 at 7 pm. Box office 631-207-1313; main office 631-207-1300. We found no house rule about dancing in the aisles.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Current description is still accurate, so none proposed. Main office line 631-207-1300 (from earlier notes) is not shown on the home page; we kept the box office number. TikTok and YouTube are not linked from the site but match by name, Patchogue location and content.
hours: Box office Wed-Sun 12 PM-6 PM; longer hours on show nights
